final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.team_id AS team_id, AVG(CAST(mh.w AS REAL) / NULLIF(mh.g, 0)) AS a, COUNT(mh.player_id) AS c FROM team t LEFT JOIN manager_half mh ON mh.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM s1) SELECT s1.team_id, s1.a, s1.c, s1.a - s2.b AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
